row: Welcome to the Virtual Sports Injury Clinic - information on over 300 sports injuries with symptoms, treatment, rehab, exercises, stretching, massage and more. We offer information on injuries from plantar fasciitis through to knee pain; groin strain to MCL injuries; Jumper's knee to ITB. We offer advice on preventing, assessing, treating and rehabilitation of injuries from soccer, swimming, tennis, athletics, rugby, running, cycling, football, netball.
